title: What If an Asteroid Hit the Moon in 2032? There's a Real 4% Chance

scenes.text: What if an asteroid hit the Moon in 2032? The Moon would be fine. Your satellites wouldn't.
Asteroid 2024 YR4 is about sixty meters wide. On December 22, 2032, it has roughly a four percent chance of hitting the Moon.
The blast: about six million tons of TNT, a crater around one kilometer wide, a flash you could see from Earth.
Up to a hundred thousand tons of lunar rock would be flung toward Earth. Three to five days later, it arrives.
Around Christmas 2032, a meteor storm. Up to one shooting star every second, for days.
But those sand grains hit satellites at ten to a thousand times the normal rate. The best light show of your life, and a bill nobody has counted.

description:
What if asteroid 2024 YR4 hit the Moon on December 22, 2032? Astronomers currently give it about a 4 percent chance.
The 60 meter rock would hit with the energy of roughly 6 million tons of TNT, carve a crater about 1 kilometer wide and fling up to 100,000 tons of lunar debris toward Earth, arriving 3 to 5 days later as a meteor storm of up to one shooting star a second. A 2025 study warns the same grains could hit satellites at 10 to 1,000 times the usual rate.
What should we run through next?
